DESCRIPTION.text:
Package: foo
Type: Package
Title: Statistical Models with Foo
Version: 1.8.0
Authors@R:
    person("Foo", "Contributors", role = c("aut", "cre"),
           email = "maintainers@example.com")
Author: Foo Contributors [aut, cre]
Maintainer: Foo Contributors <maintainers@example.com>
Description: R bindings for the Foo statistical library. The package exposes a
    small model-fitting API used by Diplodocus's acceptance workspace.
License: MIT + file LICENSE
Encoding: UTF-8
Depends:
    R (>= 4.3)
Imports:
    stats
Suggests:
    testthat (>= 3.2.0)
Config/testthat/edition: 3
NeedsCompilation: no

supplied model with its fitted values replaced.
Fit a deterministic baseline model through an S3 generic.
The default method records a zero coefficient for each feature and uses the
mean response as the intercept. The simple estimator keeps this acceptance
fixture deterministic while exercising generic and method extraction.

blocks.source:
features <- matrix(c(0, 1), ncol = 1)
model <- fit(features, c(1, 3))
model$intercept

fit(model, features, c(2, 4), tolerance = 1e-6)
